title: Default verify scratch under os.tmpdir() can land on a size-capped tmpfs
body:
Since #1312 the default screening verify scratch is join(os.tmpdir(), 'krn-screen-scratch'); on a host without TMPDIR that is /tmp, a size-capped tmpfs, while the cache cap is 8 GB.
Outcome: verify exits non-zero with a named reason (or relocates) when the scratch filesystem is tmpfs or has less free space than the cache cap plus floor.
Proof: a test with a stubbed fs probe asserts the refusal message (pass/fail).
Files: evals/units/screening.ts, test/evals/screening-units.test.ts
